review.summary: Architecture sound: facade imports once with no gameplay World reconstruction; dispatcher compile-time exhaustive over all 38 ActionAst variants with truthful soft/hard refusal semantics; every non-traversal transport enforces the 16 KiB kernel payload bound through a verified enforcement chain (kernel registration/request/reply checks down to the owners observation bound); accounting exact with distinct per-transport policies, session-witness guards and scoped publication permits; agent-facing consumers genuinely cut over with the legacy path honestly retained as oracle; three goldens bit-for-bit unchanged while the facade matches the oracle bit-for-bit across the combined script, mid-script reload continuation and refusal evidence. The geography-payload finding is correctly characterized, honestly documented and provably safe (truthful Err, state untouched, independently verified).

limits: 16 KiB kernel payload limits unchanged; no limit raised inside the audit
boundary_finding: The 16 KiB transports (wait/I4, movement/I5, inventory/I6, item_effects/I7, services/I8, monster/I3, timer/I2e) carry GeographyFacts containing the full DungeonLevel. Fresh levels serialize to 15.4-17.4 KiB depending on seed (measured over seeds 1-200); 38 of 60 seeds exceed 16384 bytes, so the facade truthfully refuses Wait/Move (Err, state untouched) on most fresh worlds; the refusal blast radius covers every geography-reading transport while CancelZapSelection (I1, no geography read) and Descend/Ascend (I9, 8 MiB) still succeed. Traversal (I9) is the accepted precedent for larger limits (8 MiB). Documented as an open boundary; fix options for a future increment: (a) compact geography facts (transport redesign, preferred), or (b) architecture-approved bound raise (scoped and justified).

evidence.combined_script: 24-step ActionAst script (Wait, Move, PickUp, Wield, Drop, OpenDoor, CloseDoor, Kick, MeleeAttack, Search, Untrap, Quaff, Read, Eat, Engrave, ZapWand, Pray, Pay, CancelZapSelection, Descend, Ascend) through one continuous OwnerGameSession on a fresh world (seed 8, 530-byte geography headroom after fixture additions), bit-for-bit vs the legacy step_player_action oracle at every step (returned events, cumulative event log, full native state including the RNG stream); traversal phase verified via depth/stored_levels
evidence.retained_continuation: session re-imported mid-script (split_at(14)); the reloaded session matches the uninterrupted facade and the legacy oracle three-way bit-for-bit
evidence.refusal: soft refusals (Descend without stairs, Quaff/Read/Fire on empty or invalid selections) match legacy exactly; the hard helpless-cancellation refusal returns a truthful Err with the state untouched, then Wait succeeds
evidence.payload_boundary: seeds 1..=16: geography size <= 16384 iff Wait+Move dispatch Ok; over-bound worlds refuse both with the state untouched; both sides exercised (within >= 8, over >= 4)
